FAQ

Answers to your questions

What do I need to get started?

Just your business name, what you sell and what results you want — that's enough. We'll take care of the planning, design and all the technical work.

How long will the work take?

It depends on the type of work. A landing page is usually ready within a few days, while an e-commerce website takes a bit longer. We give you an exact timeline with the quotation — and we stick to it.

How much will it cost?

Every project's scope is different, so pricing differs too. In a free consultation we listen to your needs and give you an exact quotation — with no hidden costs before work begins.

I live outside Dhaka — can I still get the service?

Absolutely. We provide 100% online service across Bangladesh. Discussion, payment and delivery — everything happens over WhatsApp and online.

What if I need updates or face a problem after the website is built?

You'll get support after launch too. Adding products, changing prices or any problem at all — just message us on WhatsApp and we'll sort it out.
